conclusion: Previous +49.10 ms median regression did not reproduce; observations favor test/environment variability over a stable code regression. Tail behavior remains uncertain; no claim of zero cost or universal speedup. The audit did not change runtime; hidden SVG skipping was subsequently restored without replacing the client.

gate.inference: Primary process unit: paired differences of per-process warm medians, D minus B; fixed-seed paired cluster bootstrap 20000 resamples, 95% interval. Systematic regression supported only if interval lower bound > 0 and >=6/8 pair differences positive. If interval includes zero and direction does not reproduce original result, compare against prespecified same-code split; report as no reproducible regression evidence, not proof of zero cost. If unresolved, say unresolved.
gate.rules: All runs and slow samples retained. New profile label per process. No debugger, trace, builds, unit tests or in-critical-path samplers. CPU snapshots occur before click and after completion. Display/system sleep prevented for entire campaign. No runtime code changes or installation.
